kjv.text: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.

bsb.text: Behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus.

web.text: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’

leads.kjv: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.

reasons: morning.phrase is not found word for word in the note

flow.say: Henry shows how Mary receives an honor that no other woman has ever known.
She will be a virgin and a mother, and she will name her son Jesus herself.
Eve was promised motherhood but with sorrow and submission to her husband. Mary gets motherhood without that burden.

morning.say: Carry with you today the truth that God gives his greatest honors to the humble and overlooked.
morning.phrase: she shall have the honour without the allay
